Realisierter Netto-Gewinn oder -Verlust: Realized net profit or loss of all closed trades, with the number of trades.
Aktueller Kontostand (Startkapital plus: Current balance (starting capital plus net P&L) and total P&L.
Anteil der Gewinn-Trades an allen Trades: Share of winning trades among all trades, as a half circle with winners, break-even and losers.
Summe aller Gewinne geteilt durch Summe: Sum of all profits divided by the sum of all losses, as a ring chart.
Gewinntage geteilt durch alle Handelstag: Winning days divided by all trading days.
Durchschnittlicher Gewinn und Verlust pr: Average profit and loss per trade as bars in relation to each other.
(Trefferquote × Ø Gewinn) − (Verlustquot: (Win rate × avg win) − (loss rate × avg loss).
Winning or losing days in a row.
Gewinn-Trades oder Verlust-Trades in Fol: Winning or losing trades in a row.
Größter Rückgang vom Höchststand, in Wäh: Largest decline from the peak, in currency and percent, with date.
Durchschnittlicher Rückgang vom Höchstst: Average decline from the peak in the selected period.
Kontogröße aus den Einstellungen plus Ne: Account size from the settings plus the period's net P&L. Below it the total P&L.
Trefferquote × Ø Gewinn minus Verlustquo: Win rate × avg win minus loss rate × avg loss. What a trade earns on average.
Handelstage in Folge mit gleichem Vorzei: Trading days in a row with the same sign. Red for losing days, green for winning days. The pills show the longest losing and winning streaks.
Geschlossene Trades in Folge mit gleiche: Closed trades in a row with the same result. Break-even trades are skipped. The pills show the longest losing and winning streaks.
Links die aktuelle Tages-Serie, rechts d: Left the current day streak, right the current trade streak. Red for losses, green for wins. The pills show the longest losing and winning streak of each.
Größter Rückgang der kumulierten Ergebni: Largest decline of the cumulative P&L curve from a high to the following low, in currency and as a percentage of the balance at the high.
Mittelwert aller Drawdown-Phasen (vom Ho: Average of all drawdown phases (from the high to the lowest point) in the period. Below it the current distance to the high.
Laufende Werte bis zum jeweiligen Handel: Running values up to each trading day: win rate (right axis), avg win and avg loss (left axis).
Jeder Punkt ist ein geschlossener Trade:: Each dot is a closed trade: horizontally the time of day (entry or exit, selectable via the gear), vertically the net result. Blue dots are break-even trades.
Each dot is a closed trade: horizontally the holding time (logarithmic), vertically the net result. Blue dots are break-even trades.
Säulen: Netto-Ergebnis je Handelstag. Fl: Bars: net result per trading day. Area and line: cumulative result in the period.
Kontogröße aus den Einstellungen plus ku: Account size from the settings plus the cumulative net result per trading day. The dashed line is the starting capital.
Abstand der kumulierten Ergebniskurve zu: Distance of the cumulative P&L curve from its previous high per trading day. Zero means a new high.
Gewinnziel und Verlustlimit legst du übe: Set the profit target and loss limit via the gear. The upper bar shows the way to the target, the lower one how much of the allowed loss is used. Optionally from a start date.
Kompakter Monatsblick: grün bei Gewinnta: Compact month view: green for a winning day, red for a losing day, gray for break-even. Hover to see the result.
Monatsansicht mit Netto-Ergebnis je Tag: Month view with the net result per day and, on the right, the weekly result with the number of trading days.
Ein Kästchen pro Tag der letzten 13 Woch: One box per day of the last 13 weeks. The more of your trading rules you ticked off that day, the stronger the color. The day score counts the rules ticked off today. Manage rules in the settings, tick them off in the Progress tab.
Laufende Werte je Handelstag (oder Woche: Running values per trading day (or week/month) for the selected metrics. Via the gear you choose up to three metrics, color and style.
Jede Zeile ist ein Jahr, jedes Kästchen: Each row is a year, each box a month with the number of trades. P&L: green for profit, red for loss. Win rate and trades: the stronger the blue, the higher the value. On the right the yearly result.
